title: Forged in the Dark Score (third-party content)
description: Frontmatter contract for a Forged-in-the-Dark score — a droppable operation/situation the crew can take on. Maps to a Sled Dog expedition-style entry. Write from the Blades in the Dark SRD vocabulary; use no Duskwall setting text, NPCs, art, or maps.

slug.description: kebab-case, no leading 'the-'. Sled Dog namespaces it (e.g. ext:<author>:<slug>).

summary.description: One-line hook shown on the crew's Manage content page.

description.description: The Situation — the target, the opportunity, and why now.

scoreType.description: The kind of operation this is (informs the engagement roll).

target.description: What the crew is after — the mark, the prize, the objective.

patron.description: Who offers or benefits from the job, if anyone.

opposition.description: Factions/forces standing in the way (name + a line on how they resist).

engagement.description: Notes on the engagement roll — what raises or lowers the crew's starting position.

obstacles.description: Keyed complications/obstacles the crew will hit.

hooks.description: Reasons the crew takes the job.

images.description: Optional images shipped to the party image gallery when this module is installed (a supporter feature). Files live beside this .md in the content repo; Sled Dog serves them from GitHub raw, pinned to the content commit.

file.description: Path to the image relative to this module folder (e.g. "art/homefront.png"). No leading slash, no "..".

caption.description: Short title shown on the gallery card.

description.description: Longer notes shown when the card is expanded.

url.description: A published Supabase public URL (paid packs). Alternative to `file`.

pack.description: For paid-pack content only: the pack slug this item belongs to.
